Name: Adjustable Bite Rate Fishing
Author: hashtagteardrop
Description:
I built this quick mod to adjust bite times. I hated sitting around waiting for a bite. For Vanilla experience I used alongside TimeSpeed to speed up time and bite rate together.

✅ [b]Features[/b]:
[list]
[*]Adjust the time it takes for fish to bite after casting your line.
[*]Configurable [b]Bite Rate Multiplier[/b] via [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] (GMCM).
[*]Does [b]not[/b] modify the fishing mini-game mechanics—just the waiting time.
[*]No Harmony or complicated dependencies—simple and compatible with most setups.
[/list]
🎣 [b]Bite Rate Multiplier Settings[/b]✅ [b]What It Does[/b]:
[list]
[*]Controls how quickly fish bite after casting your line.
[*]Lower values make bites happen faster.
[*]Higher values slow down the bite rate.
[/list][list]
[/list][b]Bite Rate Multiplier Table- Adjustable through GMCM[/b]
Multiplier: 0.1
Effect: Very fast bites (90% faster)
Multiplier: 0.5
Effect: Half the usual wait time
Multiplier: 0.67
Effect: Matches 1.5x faster game time
Multiplier: 1.0
Effect: Vanilla/default bite speed
Multiplier: 1.5
Effect: 50% longer wait time
Multiplier: 2.0
Effect: Twice the usual wait time


No guarantee it's compatible with other fishing mods. I currently use Yet Another Fishing Mod with no problems

Downloads.Description: Extract into mod folder and enjoy
